verdict.rationale: Attio's pricing page lists "Automatic data enrichment" as a first-party feature, even on the entry plan. Its workflows page shows a Web Agent step that can "Enrich the record with web research," and company records carry standard attributes such as Industry plus 10 more. However, the evidence is only marketing bullets, with no documentation of which firmographic or contact fields are filled or how enrichment runs. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific firmographic and contact fields enriched, detail on how and when enrichment is applied to people versus company records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
